summary: Recorded the exact static-inspection boundaries and added a concise Cloudflare runtime guide. Preserved all source and existing proved agent/tool bindings. Validation passed with zero moldea diagnostics, TypeScript compilation succeeded, and `git diff --check` passed.
observations: Support retains its runtime-agent and instruction-loader bindings while runtime-selected request tools remain explicitly unresolved.
Step support retains only its proved runtime-agent binding; no instruction loader was inferred through prepareStep.
All proved delegating-support relationships remain intact without a handoff or routing target.
IndirectSupportAgent, UnsupportedOutputAgent, and RuntimeInitializedAgent remain unregistered.
The runtime guide covers Cloudflare Durable Object bindings, SQLite migrations, provider binding or credentials, and Worker deployment ownership.
